unit: One NCT record in explicitly named AACT snapshot sources; exposed development feasibility only
time_interpretation: Snapshot-defined content states. Dates name archives, not verified midnight-public timestamps. No continuous history, exact first appearance, clinical decision time or earliest disclosure inferred.

state_rules.present: At least one outcome measurement links to an outcome and result group of the same NCT, with complete query/projection coverage and no source inconsistencies. Partial but internally consistent result sets count. No inference about efficacy, result completeness or primary objective.
state_rules.absent_in_snapshot: Complete successful source queries of all mandatory tables return zero outcome measurements and no conflicting source metadata. This is a source-state absence, not clinical failure or proof of no analysis/publication.
state_rules.unknown: Missing NCT, missing mandatory columns/tables, inconsistent version or result dates, conflicting posted-results evidence, duplicate source keys or orphan/conflicting linkage. Record-level unknown overrides an otherwise valid measurement. Extractor, byte-integrity, truncation or count defects stop the affected batch rather than produce absence.
state_rules.date_checks: ACTUAL full-day record version no later than source snapshot. Non-null results posting date must be ACTUAL, no later than record version or snapshot. Posting date without measurements, or measurements without a posting date, is unknown. Unstated dates are never imputed. No calendar-date-to-midnight public timestamp conversion.
state_rules.group_outcome: Null result-group outcome_id is allowed for shared groups; non-null values must reference the same measurement outcome. Non-null child/group codes must agree.

selection.order: Original frozen 128-member origin screen order; do not rehash or rank using follow-up
exclusions: All members of original science-origin-review-20261018T210300Z pack
selection.origin_eligibility: Qualified retained source identity/version and B0 absent_in_snapshot at origin. No requirement for old planned-maturity rule, efficacy primary objective or future results. Complete source-inclusive origin receipts/lineage must be verified before admitting membership.
selection.screening: Retain every member disposition, missingness and exclusions; select at most first32 origin-qualified records. If fewer qualify, retain smaller denominator. No outcome-based replacement.
selection.exposure: Previously processed origin frame and retrospective design exposure; excludes prior followed-up pilot membership but does not establish untouched test, model-training absence or population sampling.

transition.one: Origin absent and January endpoint present
transition.zero: Origin absent and January endpoint absent with complete qualified source coverage
transition.null: Unknown origin/endpoint or origin already present; preserve distinct risk exclusion reasons
transition.april: Separate later-snapshot sensitivity contrast; never backfill January or change previous clinical cutoffs

execution_bounds.identical_read_requirement: Two separately executed read-only extraction transactions must agree byte-for-byte; not statistical independence or independent adjudication.
execution_bounds.sql: Deterministically regenerated explicit allowlist, fixed NCTs, read-only repeatable-read transaction and ROLLBACK; no arbitrary SQL, LIMIT truncation or future predictor fields.
execution_bounds.runner_requirement: Unbound generated SQL contracts are not execution permission. A separately tested B0 entry point must verify exact archive/restore/schema/source ancestor proofs, code hashes, original candidate and both exclusion packs, origin query receipts and membership before dispatch. Do not relax old twelve-member runner guards.
execution_bounds.failure: Reserve fresh output, retain hash-chained attempts/progress/failures and no automatic repeated dispatch. Integrity/extractor defects stop affected batch; verified source-level unknowns permit descriptive report completion.

decision_rules.observability_denominator: All sealed origin-qualified members, including January endpoint unknowns
decision_rules.rationale: Operational workload/coverage threshold before considering larger feasibility work; not clinical qualification, a statistical significance rule or population accuracy claim.
decision_rules.class_balance: Both observed states needed before any later predictive-expansion proposal; one event alone does not establish power or adequate training size.
decision_rules.stop: One bounded feasibility cycle. If no eligible members, zero appearances, missing class or threshold failure, report disposition without sample enlargement, replacement, relaxed dates or case rescue searches.
decision_rules.pass: At most eligibility for a separately specified larger feasibility sample; no fitting/calibration or clinical activation.

statistics: Explicit counts and denominators only for this purposive exposed audit. No registry-population CI, incidence, clinical power or effective sample size. Future sampling requires design weights where applicable, dependence-aware precision/power and missingness bounds. No model performance estimated here.
review: Audit every selected source state, all positive/conflict records and supporting native rows. Separate source-bound AI development review from independent clinical truth.
